scripts.text:
[Malangdo Guide]
Nice to meet you, welcome to ^8C4210Malangdo^000000. The island of cat paw!
Need some guidance?

[綿綿島嚮導]
很高興見到你，歡迎來到貓爪之島^8C4210綿綿島^000000！
需要我指路嗎？
